description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח מכלול - חסר ביטוח
description.summary: This table details the implications of underinsurance according to the 'Mecholal' policy. It explains how benefits are reduced if the insured sum is lower than required, and exceptions for data/software restoration and additional operating expenses.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי החסר ביטוח בפוליסת 'מכלול' לעסק. במקרה של אירוע ביטוחי, אם סכום הביטוח המצוין בתוכנית נמוך מהסכום הנדרש, תשלום הפיצויים יופחת באופן יחסי. תנאים אלו אינם חלים על כיסויים נוספים לשיחזור נתונים ותוכנה ולהוצאות תפעול נוספות, אשר כפופים לתנאים המפורטים בסעיפים 4.1.5.1 ו-4.2.6.1 בהתאמה. סעיף 5.3 עוסק בחסר ביטוח, סעיפים 4.1 ו-4.2 עוסקים בכיסוי לשיחזור נתונים ותוכנה ובהוצאות תפעול נוספות, בהתאמה. יחס בין סכום הביטוח המצוין לבין הסכום שהיה צריך לבטח הוא קריטי.
notable_values: Paragraph 5.1: basis for determining the sum insured
Paragraph 4.1: cover for data and software restoration
Paragraph 4.2: cover for additional operating expenses
Paragraph 4.2.6.1: terms for additional operating expenses

sketch:
5.3 Underinsurance
If, at the time of the occurrence of the insured event, the sum insured specified in the schedule for Chapter Four is lower than the sum insured required in accordance with paragraph 5.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured), the insurer's liability will be reduced and the insurance benefits will be paid only partially, according to the ratio between the sum insured specified in the schedule for Chapter Four and the sum which should have been insured in accordance with whatsoever appearing in paragraph 5.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured).
Whatsoever appearing in this condition shall not apply with the additional covers listed in paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2 above (cover for data and software restoration as well as cover for additional operating expenses, respectively), in respect of which whatsoever appearing in paragraphs 4.1.5.1 and 4.2.6.1 respectively shall apply (on a first loss basis).

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח מכלול - חסר ביטוח
This table details the implications of underinsurance according to the 'Mecholal' policy. It explains how benefits are reduced if the insured sum is lower than required, and exceptions for data/software restoration and additional operating expenses.
ממדים: Condition related to underinsurance, Aspect of underinsurance calculation/application

5.3 Underinsurance
If, at the time of the occurrence of the insured event, the sum insured specified in the schedule for Chapter Four is lower than the sum insured required in accordance with paragraph 5.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured), the insurer's liability will be reduced and the insurance benefits will be paid only partially, according to the ratio between the sum insured specified in the schedule for Chapter Four and the sum which should have been insured in accordance with whatsoever appearing in paragraph 5.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured).
Whatsoever appearing in this condition shall not apply with the additional covers listed in paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2 above (cover for data and software restoration as well as cover for additional operating expenses, respectively), in respect of which whatsoever appearing in paragraphs 4.1.5.1 and 4.2.6.1 respectively shall apply (on a first loss basis).
